description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single attacks at Cap Break Level 1, grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], Cap Break Level 1, [Instant ATB 1], Crystal Mode to user
Crystal Mode: Wind Ability Boost, Dualcast Wind, Zero Hone Cost to Wind Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 8 single-target Wind/NE magic attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, [Quick Cast, Wind Ability Damage +30% & 50% DEF/RES Pierce] for 2 turns & Quick ATB 1 to user; After using Crystal Force II, chases a Wind ability with Instant ATB 1 to user (max 1 chase)
